The '''''Banthar''''' was one of two [[BFF-1 bulk freighter/Legends|BFF-1 bulk freighters]] sent to pick up a supply commerce consisting of several cargo containers being readied for shipment by [[CT-11 space tug]]s and deliver them to the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial]] [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]]. Two [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|Y-wings]] [[Raid above Bonadan|arrived]] and destroyed the [[Cargo container/Legends|cargo containers]] and the two [[Freighter/Legends|freighters]] before the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate/Legends|Nebulon-B escort frigate]] [[Enforcer (EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate)|''Enforcer'']] could arrive.

==History==
In the early years of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], [[Bonadan/Legends|Bonadan]] was under the control of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. The Imperials then set up a supply commerce consisting of several [[Cargo container/Legends|cargo containers]] being readied for shipment by [[CT-11 space tug]]s. Two [[BFF-1 bulk freighter/Legends|BFF-1 bulk freighters]], ''[[Deddite]]'' and ''Banthar'', were to pick up the cargo and deliver them to the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial]] [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]]. However, two [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|Y-wings]] [[Raid above Bonadan|arrived]] and destroyed the containers and the two [[Freighter/Legends|freighters]] before the Imperial [[EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate/Legends|EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate]] [[Enforcer (EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate)|''Enforcer'']] could arrive.<ref name="X-Wing" />
